shell.label: Administration
shell.deniedDescription: This area is open only to invited editorial members. Reader accounts cannot access administration; editorial access is granted only through an admin’s invitation.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.intro: Your session and editorial membership were verified on the server.

roleDescriptions.admin: You can manage members, assign roles, and have every content permission.
roleDescriptions.editor: You can create, edit, and publish any post. Member management is reserved for admins.
roleDescriptions.author: You can create and edit your own drafts. Publishing and member management belong to other roles.

dashboard.features: Drafts, the body editor, images and YouTube embeds, categories, tags, and ordered author credits are ready. Editors and admins can publish and unpublish posts.
dashboard.contentDescription: Create drafts, edit metadata, or open the members-only preview.
dashboard.membersDescription: Invite editorial members, change their roles, or deactivate them.

error.title: This administration page could not be loaded
error.description: Something went wrong while loading the data. Try again; if the problem persists, refresh your session.

missing.title: Record not found
missing.description: This record does not exist or you are not allowed to view it.

actions.sessionMissing: No session found. Please sign in again.
actions.fixErrors: Fix the errors in the form.
actions.confirmDelete: Tick the box to confirm the deletion.
actions.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Your input was kept; try again in a few minutes.
actions.failed: The action could not be completed. Try again.
